key_insight: The paper introduces an explainable agentic system that detects multi-turn conversational scams by combining single-message phishing detection with summary-based memory for conversation-level reasoning.
engineering_relevance: It suggests a practical path for deployable scam defense systems that can monitor long-running conversations, preserve context efficiently, and provide interpretable alerts for users or moderators.
method: Extend a single-message phishing detector to a conversation-level agent.
Maintain summary-based memory to track evolving scam cues over time.
Release ConScamBench-278, a public benchmark covering 8 conversational scam types.
evidence_signal: The system detected all 83/83 scams in LoveFraud02 and achieved 97.8% accuracy on ConScamBench-278, while the single-message detector reached 100% phishing recall.
watch_item: Results on the new benchmark and user studies are promising, but broader real-world validation is still needed before relying on the system for high-stakes deployment.
paper_title: An Explainable Agentic System for Detection of Conversational Scams with Summary-Based Memory
